about: Packages CleanYourHeadUnit never disables. Rules are checked in order; the first match wins. 'core' rules can never be overridden by anything, not a profile, not a flag. 'vehicle' and 'keyword' rules can only be overridden by a package entry in the telemetry catalogue or a device profile that carries its own evidence.

core.reason: Core Android. With one of these disabled Android itself can stop booting.
core.source: CleanYourTV tools/disable.sh CORE_RE by @Gathin23 (issues #884, #1711, #2557, #2803 there), TV middleware entries removed

core.reason: Radios, telephony, input and system web content. Bluetooth calling, Wi-Fi, mobile data, the on-screen keyboard and emergency broadcasts depend on these.

vehicle.reason: FYT firmware system apps. com.syu.ms is the main MCU service (keys, volume, sleep), com.syu.air is the navigation bar, and the rest drive radio, Bluetooth, CAN bus and camera.
vehicle.source: XDA: FYT based Spreadtrum uis7862 thread; github.com/PimpinPumpkin/fyt7862-mods (com.syu.ms, com.syu.air)

vehicle.reason: MTCD/MTCE (PX5/PX6 HCT-type) firmware apps and the MCU service: radio, Bluetooth, steering-wheel keys, car settings.
vehicle.source: XDA MTCD/MTCE firmware threads (community, not verified on hardware here)

vehicle.reason: Vendor namespace used by DoFun units (com.tw.core). Other com.tw apps may carry vehicle functions. Only the catalogue entries for com.tw.core and com.tw.jar1 say more.
vehicle.source: Kaspersky Securelist, 2026, 'First Android malware targeting automotive head units'

keyword.about: A package outside the com.android/com.google.android/android namespaces is treated as Protected when a part of its name (split on dots, digits and underscores) equals one of these words, or starts with one of them when the word has 4 or more letters or is listed in prefix_short. Example: com.vendor.canbus, com.vendor.carsettings, com.vendor.mcuservice.
keyword.reason: The name suggests a vehicle or firmware function. Kept until a tested device profile proves it is not needed.
